metadata.scenario: An individual inquires about the opening hours of the local library. Category: General Information. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I’m just calling to inquire about the opening hours of the local library. Oh, I’m sorry, but I don't have that information. Would you like to speak with someone who can assist you in that regard? Yes, please. That would be helpful. I can take a note and follow up with you later if you’d like. That would be great! I really need to check out some books. Alright, let me just confirm a couple of details. You mentioned you’re a regular client, correct? Yes, I’ve been receiving physical therapy services from you for about nine months. That’s right, I remember! How has your recovery been progressing? It’s been good, though some days are tougher than others, especially after my last visit. I understand. If you ever feel you need additional support, let me know. I appreciate that, Margaret. I might take you up on that offer soon. Absolutely. I can connect you with Dr. Rodriguez if you feel the need for extra sessions. That sounds good. I’ll think about it. But about the library... Yes, of course! I’ll make sure to gather the hours and contact you back. Great, thank you! You’re welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, I think that covers it for now. Perfect! I’ll follow up with you shortly about the library hours. Thank you for calling, Helen! Thank you, Margaret! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
